findings.description: Ordered segment labels do not enforce serial execution or a shared worker cap. Each segment independently requires only the seven inherited prerequisites and permits three workers, allowing concurrent segment invocations to exceed the shared three-worker boundary.
findings.required_correction: Require explicit serial A-through-F admission with validated predecessor-segment receipts, or specify an enforced shared global three-worker mechanism. Bind this ordering/admission rule into segment leases and union validation.
